title: nan
authors: Almalis N.; Tsihrintzis G.; Baris G.; Armenakis N.
key_contribution: Presents a federated deep reinforcement learning architecture (PPO) for multi-UAV GNSS-independent navigation and tracking, evaluated in simulation and field-tested on a Matrice 100.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
